sentences: I measure two cups of flour and level it off with the back of a knife before adding it to the mixing bowl.
I preheat the oven to 375 degrees and wait for the indicator light to turn off before sliding the pan inside.
I chop the onions into small pieces, then scrape them from the cutting board into the heated skillet with oil.
I fill the pot with water, set it on the burner, and turn the heat to high until it boils.
I stir the sauce with a wooden spoon every few minutes so it does not stick to the bottom.
I check the internal temperature of the chicken with a digital thermometer and wait until it reads 165 degrees.
I grease the baking dish with butter and dust it with flour before pouring in the batter.
I peel the potatoes over the sink, cut them into cubes, and drop them into a bowl of cold water.
I set the timer for twelve minutes and wipe down the counter while the rice simmers in the covered pot.
I sauté the garlic in olive oil for thirty seconds, then add the chopped tomatoes and stir them together.
I knead the dough on a floured surface for ten minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
I let the dough rise in a warm place for an hour, then punch it down and shape it into a loaf.
I grate the cheese on the large holes of the box grater and set the shreds aside in a small bowl.
I whisk the eggs with a fork until the yolks and whites are fully combined and slightly frothy.
I drain the pasta in a colander, then return it to the pot and toss it with the tomato sauce.
I taste the soup from a spoon, add a pinch of salt, and stir it once more before serving.
I line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the vegetables in a single layer before roasting.
I pour the leftover stew into a container, label it with the date, and place it in the refrigerator.
I soak the dried beans overnight, then rinse them in the morning and simmer them with a bay leaf.
I wipe the cutting board with a damp cloth, wash the knives by hand, and leave the dishes in the rack to dry.
